note: The biome look bible as data (docs/art/biomes.md, docs/art/biomes-pages.md). Written by art/concepts/biomes/gen.mjs; do not edit by hand. Noon colours: the world-light tint per key (data/art/sky.json) multiplies them. Proposals pending Orb, Rendering and VFX; Tools adds the schema.

rules.faces: lit, mid and shade are the three faces of one surface; flat colours with the keyline (#0a0d14); no gradients, no blur, no fades
rules.readability: an aura stays 20 or more CIEDE2000 from every ground, rock, vegetation and water tone and a body 15 or more from ground, rock and vegetation, at every sky key with the world-light tint (the rival coat and the sea are advisory)
rules.far_land: three ridges, each hazed toward the horizon: far1 nearest and darkest
rules.orbit: the colour a biome reads as from far away, 12 percent toward the atmosphere blue (8 for ice)

ocean.name: Open ocean
ocean.line: a faceted swell under a clean horizon; the sea owns mid blue

damage.scorch: a steam line along the surface where the beam crossed, and a dark wake: the sea does not scar, so it is the only mark and it is gone in about two seconds
damage.crater: a bowl of water: the surface drops 40 units, a faceted ring of swell runs out and the bowl fills from the sides
damage.burned: charred wreckage and a few burning planks float on the swell; steam banks stand over them

ocean.destruction: A water column: a tall pale core, a collapsing cap, then a faceted ring wave. Spray is cut crystals of pale blue, never a soft cloud.

neighbours.note: The sea shallows in three hard steps (deep, mid, shallow) and a pale foam line runs along the sand; wet sand is a darker band above it.
The sea darkens to polar water and floe fragments appear, thickening into the pack; the floe edges are slate.
A river-mouth: the shallows go tea-green in steps, reed islands stand out in the water, the shoreline is a mud bank.
Black cliffs drop straight into the sea; sea stacks stand off the cliff; a thin steam vent stands on the shore (grey facets).

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

plains.name: Plains
plains.line: rolling meadow; scattered broadleaf trees, boulders, tufts

damage.scorch: a long black band scorched into the grass, the edge ragged and still smoking in a thin grey thread; the soil under it is dark brown
damage.crater: a round bowl of brown soil with a raised torn rim and grass divots on it
damage.burned: the grass burnt to ash-grey stubble in a wide patch, trees charred to black trunks with a few bare branches

plains.destruction: Dirt and divots: brown clods and green turf chunks in an arc, a low wide dust cloud in the soil's colour.

neighbours.note: Sand gives way to dune grass tufts, then grass; one low dune ridge between.
Parkland: lone trees, then groves, then closed forest; the grass shortens under the trees.
The green dries to gold in steps; acacias appear among the grass; the first red earth shows.
Grass breaks into tufts on bare sand; scrub, then dunes; the ground steps from green to gold in five hard bands.
Foothills: the hills rise in steps, rock outcrops through the grass, fir groves on the slopes.
Sparse spruce on cold grass; moss replaces the grass; the first snow patches in hollows.
Pools open in the grass, reeds ring them, the grass grows darker and wetter.
Meadow gives way to moor: heather mounds and bracken among the grass, the first granite boulders, the ground rising in low humps.

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

forest.name: Temperate forest
forest.line: dense broadleaf and fir; a green floor; a leaf-litter ground

damage.scorch: a black band through the trees: trunks charred on one side, canopy singed brown, the leaf litter burnt to black
damage.crater: a bowl of dark loam with a ring of felled trunks lying away from it like spokes
damage.burned: a standing burn: black trunks with no leaves, orange-brown scorched canopy at the edges, a grey ash floor

forest.destruction: Leaf shred and splinters: green and orange leaf shards swirl, pale splinters and bark chunks arc out, a dark dirt cloud below.

neighbours.note: Parkland: lone trees, then groves, then closed forest; the grass shortens under the trees.
The trees get taller and the canopy closes; giant leaves appear under them; the green shifts toward yellow-green.
Broadleaf gives way to spruce; the trees narrow and darken; moss and snow patches take the floor.
The tree line climbs the slope: tall firs, then small firs, then scree and rock.
A swamp forest: trees stand in shallow water with arched roots; the floor is mud.
The wood thins to wind-bent trees on heather; granite boulders stand in the clearings.

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

desert.name: Desert
desert.line: long dunes with a steep lee, red mesas, cacti and scrub; sun-bleached

damage.scorch: a glass trench: the sand fused into a dark green-black glassy band with a bright pale edge (the prototype's GLASS TRENCH)
damage.crater: a deep clean bowl with a sharp rim; the dune lee collapses into it, the inside packed darker orange sand
damage.burned: fused glass patches and black-scorched rock; cacti blackened and split; the dunes streaked grey with ash

desert.destruction: A sand plume: tall, wide, pale gold with a darker core; it falls fast and the dune face slumps and slides for a second.

neighbours.note: The dune sea runs to the shore; only the sand colour steps from pale to gold; no grass at all.
Grass breaks into tufts on bare sand; scrub, then dunes; the ground steps from green to gold in five hard bands.
Thorn scrub thins; red earth takes over from gold grass; acacias become single trees.
Badlands: red mesas and scree fans spill from the grey rock; no soil between.
A black lava plain with sand drifted in streaks; basalt columns; the sand steps to black.
Dry moor: the sand turns to bare weathered rock and thin heather; tors stand on the ridges.

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

mountains.name: Mountains
mountains.line: grey faceted rock, snow on the shade side, conifers low down, scree

damage.scorch: a black soot streak along the rock, snow on it melted to a dark wet line, the scree glassy in the middle
damage.crater: a bowl in broken rock, the rim a ring of angular blocks and a skirt of scree sliding down the slope
damage.burned: conifers charred black, snow patches grey with soot, bare pale rock where the slope slid

mountains.destruction: Rock shards: angular chunks on long arcs and a grey dust cloud; on a slope the scree slides downhill for two seconds.

neighbours.note: Foothills: the hills rise in steps, rock outcrops through the grass, fir groves on the slopes.
The tree line climbs the slope: tall firs, then small firs, then scree and rock.
A cloud forest: the canopy stays but the ridges rise behind it, darker; ferns on the rock.
Badlands: red mesas and scree fans spill from the grey rock; no soil between.
The rock turns from grey to black, ash slopes replace scree, a cone stands behind.
Tall spruce thin up the slope to small ones, then scree; snow lies in the folds.
Bare rock above, lichen and stunted scrub below, snow in the folds.
Glacier tongues run down between the rock ridges; the snow line is a hard step.
The crags lower into rounded heath with tors: jagged ridgelines settle into humps, snow gives way to heather.

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

ice_sheet.name: Ice sheet
ice_sheet.line: two tones: a warm-white lit face and a cold slate face; crevasses; rock peaks through

damage.scorch: a slate streak melted into the ice, the edge a thin melt-blue line (it refreezes in ten seconds)
damage.crater: a bowl in the ice with a clean blue wall and a ring of shattered white blocks; fine cracks run out along the surface
damage.burned: a dark soot band and a melt pool in a bowl; meltwater blue, the pool refreezing at its rim

ice_sheet.destruction: Ice shatter: a white powder burst and large crystal shards (cut blue facets), a slow-falling glitter of fine shards.

neighbours.note: Glacier tongues run down between the rock ridges; the snow line is a hard step.
Snow patches join into full snow cover; lichen shows only on the ridges; the ground steps to two tones.
A shelf edge: a vertical slate cliff of ice over dark water, bergs calved off it, floes beyond.

_colour_vision.rule: the preset lane auras (data/art/colour-vision.json) under each vision stay 14 or more CIEDE2000 from every tone at every sky key

sea_ice.name: Sea ice
sea_ice.line: flat floes with a warm-white top and a slate edge in dark cold water; bergs

damage.scorch: a dark slate band across the floe, the water beside it steaming for a second
damage.crater: the floe cracks in a star, the bowl floods with black water and the pieces tilt
damage.burned: a soot-black floe and a lane of steaming water; cracked floes drifting apart

sea_ice.destruction: A floe burst: white shards and chunks thrown out, black water ringing the cracks, a short column of white spray.

neighbours.note: The sea darkens to polar water and floe fragments appear, thickening into the pack; the floe edges are slate.
Shore-fast ice: a flat white shelf along the coast, floes at its edge in dark water.
A shelf edge: a vertical slate cliff of ice over dark water, bergs calved off it, floes beyond.

jungle.name: Jungle
jungle.line: tall layered canopy, buttress trunks, giant leaves, dark floor, a few vivid flowers

damage.scorch: a band where the canopy is shorn off at an angle, the leaves below browned and curled, the trunks split and pale inside
damage.crater: a bowl in black loam with torn roots and a fan of snapped trunks and cut vines around it
damage.burned: a smouldering clearing: black split trunks, scorched grey ferns, thin white-grey steam from the wet floor (steam as faceted puffs, not haze)

jungle.destruction: Shredded leaves and split trunks with a rising column of grey steam from the wet ground; bright flower petals among the debris.

neighbours.note: A palm line stands right on the sand, then the canopy wall; the jungle floor begins at the back of the beach.
A gallery forest: a dense green wall of tall trees along a river, with golden grass right up to it.
The trees get taller and the canopy closes; giant leaves appear under them; the green shifts toward yellow-green.
A mangrove swamp: prop roots, dark water, hanging vines.
A cloud forest: the canopy stays but the ridges rise behind it, darker; ferns on the rock.

savanna.name: Savanna
savanna.line: gold dry grass, flat-topped acacias, red earth showing, termite towers

damage.scorch: a black scorch band through the dry grass with a glowing-free ember edge (grey, not lit), the red earth showing in the middle
damage.crater: a round bowl of red-orange earth, the dry grass flattened outward in a star
damage.burned: a grass fire: the gold turned to black and ash-grey over a wide patch, acacia crowns gone, trunks black, termite towers dusted grey

savanna.destruction: Red-ochre dust, tall and wide, with tumbling grass clumps; it hangs a little longer than sand because the dust is fine.

neighbours.note: Dry scrub and driftwood on the sand; the sand stains toward red earth.
The green dries to gold in steps; acacias appear among the grass; the first red earth shows.
A gallery forest: a dense green wall of tall trees along a river, with golden grass right up to it.
Thorn scrub thins; red earth takes over from gold grass; acacias become single trees.
A floodplain: flat, gold grass with pools and reeds, a few acacias on the higher ground.

tundra.name: Tundra
tundra.line: open grey-green lichen ground, snow in the hollows, stunted scrub and boulders; no trees

damage.scorch: a black band through lichen and snow: the snow melted to dark wet ground, the lichen burnt to grey crisp
damage.crater: a bowl of dark frozen soil with a ring of snow thrown out, ice lenses glinting blue in the wall
damage.burned: black circles where stunted scrub burned, grey ash on the snow, the lichen gone to bare grey ground

tundra.destruction: A snow burst: a pale powder cloud that rises and falls, white and blue crystal shards, dark soil clods under it.

neighbours.note: Bare rock above, lichen and stunted scrub below, snow in the folds.
The spruce shrink and thin to single stunted trees, then none; the moss becomes lichen.
Snow patches join into full snow cover; lichen shows only on the ridges; the ground steps to two tones.
Shore-fast ice: a flat white shelf along the coast, floes at its edge in dark water.
Alpine tundra: lichen and heather mix, boulders and tors stand in the open; snow lies in the hollows.

taiga.name: Taiga
taiga.line: dense dark spruce on a mossy floor, snow lying in the hollows, narrow shadows; the boreal forest between the forest and the tundra

damage.scorch: a black band through the spruce: trunks charred on one side, needles singed rust-brown, the snow in the hollows melted to a dark line
damage.crater: a bowl of dark mossy loam with a ring of felled spruce lying outward like spokes and snow thrown over them
damage.burned: a standing burn: black bare spruce with a few rust needles, grey ash on the snow, the moss floor black

taiga.destruction: Snow and needles: a pale powder column, white and blue crystals, dark needle shards and bark chunks arcing out, a low dark dirt skirt under it.

neighbours.note: Sparse spruce on cold grass; moss replaces the grass; the first snow patches in hollows.
Broadleaf gives way to spruce; the trees narrow and darken; moss and snow patches take the floor.

wetland.name: Wetland
wetland.line: shallow tea-green water, reed beds, mangrove roots, flat mud banks

damage.scorch: a dark band along the water surface and reeds: reeds burnt to black stubs for the beam's width, the water showing a darker film for a few seconds
damage.crater: a bowl that fills at once with tea-green water and a ring of churned mud; reeds lie flat around it
damage.burned: a reed fire: tall straw reeds turned to black stubs over a patch, grey ash floating on the water in flat flakes

wetland.destruction: Mud splash: dark brown globs on arcs, flung reeds, a ring of ripple; the water goes cloudy for a moment and settles.

neighbours.note: A river-mouth: the shallows go tea-green in steps, reed islands stand out in the water, the shoreline is a mud bank.

beach.name: Beach and coast
beach.line: pale sand, a wet-sand band, a foam line; palms and dune grass behind

damage.scorch: a glassy black-green band fused into the sand (a beam path), its edge a thin pale line
damage.crater: a shallow bowl in dry sand that floods from the water side: wet-sand dark inside, a collapsed rim
damage.burned: palms standing as black trunks with no crown, dune grass burnt to stubble, grey ash drifted into the dune lee

beach.destruction: Sand and spray: a wide pale plume that settles fast, and a ring of wet dark sand around the impact.

neighbours.note: The sea shallows in three hard steps (deep, mid, shallow) and a pale foam line runs along the sand; wet sand is a darker band above it.

highland.name: Highland
highland.line: weathered grey rock, mauve heather and russet bracken, wind-bent trees, stacked granite tors; the rocky highland (not volcanic)

damage.scorch: a black soot streak across the heather and the rock, the heather burnt to a grey crust and the rock lichen to bare pale stone
damage.crater: a bowl in thin peaty soil over rock, the rim a ring of shattered granite blocks and torn heather
damage.burned: a heath fire: the heather and bracken black and ash-grey over a wide patch, the wind-bent trees black, the tors sooted dark

highland.destruction: Rock and peat: pale granite chips on long arcs, a brown-grey dust cloud with torn heather in it; a tor sheds blocks that roll downhill.

neighbours.note: Coastal heath: the sand gives way to heather and bracken on a low cliff, grey boulders at its foot.

volcanic.name: Volcanic ground
volcanic.line: black basalt, grey ash slopes, a cone with a rim, a few cooled lava flows; World's volcanic biome (the weathered rock highland is its own biome)

damage.scorch: a pale-grey fused streak on black rock, the edge faintly warm-orange in a thin static line (never flickering)
damage.crater: a bowl in ash and clinker, the inside a lighter grey with a raised ring of black blocks
damage.burned: the few shrubs black; a fresh thin orange crust of cooling rock where the fight went on (a static colour, never pulsing)

volcanic.destruction: Ash and clinker: a dark grey column that rises slowly and spreads, black blocks on arcs, a few steady orange ember chips.

neighbours.note: Black cliffs drop straight into the sea; sea stacks stand off the cliff; a thin steam vent stands on the shore (grey facets).
